'''Khaled S. Mekheimer''' is an Egyptian professor of [[Applied mathematics|Applied Mathematics]] at the Department of Mathematics Faculty of Science (Men), [[Al-Azhar University]], [[Egypt]]. He is the&nbsp; Vice Dean of Research and Post-graduate Studies of the Faculty. He is an elected member of [[African Academy of Sciences|African Academy of sciences]] and Egyptian Mathematical Society.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kh Mekheimer {{!}} The AAS |url=https://www.aasciences.africa/fellow/kh-mekheimer |access-date=2022-06-22 |website=www.aasciences.africa |archive-date=2022-06-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220622204233/https://www.aasciences.africa/fellow/kh-mekheimer |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Loop {{!}} Kh S Mekheimer |url=https://loop.frontiersin.org/people/165426/bio |access-date=2022-06-22 |website=loop.frontiersin.org}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Mekheimer was born on March 22, 1963, in [[Egypt]]. He obtained his BSc from the department of mathematics, Faculty of Science, [[Ain Shams University|Ain-Shams University]] in 1984. He moved to [[Al-Azhar University]] for his MSc and PhD and he graduated in 1990 and 1994 respectively.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Mekheimer |first=Khaleed |title=Curriculum vitae |url=http://www.bibalex.org/Einstein2005/Part3/SpeakersCV/Khaled%20Mekhemeir%20(c.v.).doc}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |date=2017-12-31 |title=Mekheimer Kh.S. |url=https://cmst.eu/authors/mekheimer-kh-s/ |journal=CMST |language=english |issn=1505-0602}}</ref>

== Career ==
Mekheimer started his career in 1986 as a demonstrator of Mathematics at [[Al-Azhar University|Al-Azhar, University, Cairo, Egypt]]. He became an assistant lecturer immediately after his MSc in 1990 and assumed the role of a lecturer after his PhD in 1994. In 1997, he moved to [[King Abdulaziz University|King Abdu Al-Aziz University]] branch, [[Medina|Madinah]] Munawwara, [[Saudi Arabia]] where he became an assistant Professor. He returned to [[Al-Azhar University]] in Cairo as an [[associate professor]] and in 2010 he became a [[Professor]] of [[Applied mathematics|Applied Mathematics]] at the Faculty of Science in the same institution.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" />
